mapping_json.fidelity_notes: The original ground-DoT bow archetype, TR's ancestor. ground_targeted_circle + poison ailment is the crosswalk-mandated home (chaos-poison -> shadow family + poison lane, §1/§2). payload.loop: Fire Caustic Arrow at enemy or ground; on impact the arrow leaves a caustic ground cloud that ticks chaos DoT to enemies standing within it. Player kites enemies through the cloud. Build does not require hitting the enemy directly — cloud damage is independent of hit/accuracy.
